title: How artificial intelligence cooperating with agent-based modeling for urban studies: A systematic review
abstract: As urbanization accelerates, cities become more complex, coming along with more complex urban issues. Agent-based model (ABM) is a traditional method to simulate activities in a complex system, which has been widely applied in urban studies. However, due to its rigid initial settings, ABM has been criticized for its lack of intelligence, especially in dealing with modern urban issues. With the success of artificial intelligence (AI) and complexity science, it is generally agreed that ABM can be enhanced with AI agents, a promising technology that can bridge the gaps. For that, this article provides a systematic review, in which 10 subsections correspond to 10 different ways that AI can work with ABM in the methodological framework. The sections include that (1) ABM is AI; (2) ABM provides training data for AI; (3) AI provides data for ABM; (4) ABM is a submodule in the ensemble AI; (5) AI leads an optimization framework with ABM participation; (6) AI tunes ABM initialization parameters; (7) AI provides the environment for ABM; (8) AI aids in choosing the agent's attributes; (9) AI provides behaviors for agents in ABM; (10) AI helps to evaluate the performance of ABM. For each case, some typical works are examined for illustration. Finally, we discuss some of the current limitations and prospects for future development.
abstractZh: 随着城市化加速，城市日益复杂，城市问题也愈加复杂。基于智能体模型（ABM）是模拟复杂系统活动的传统方法，已广泛用于城市研究。然而，由于初始设定僵化，其智能性不足受到批评，在应对现代城市问题时尤为明显。随着人工智能（AI）与复杂性科学取得进展，人们普遍认为，AI智能体可增强ABM，并有望弥合相关缺口。为此，本文开展系统综述，以十个小节对应AI与ABM在方法框架中协作的十种方式：（1）ABM本身属于AI；（2）ABM为AI提供训练数据；（3）AI为ABM提供数据；（4）ABM作为集成AI中的子模块；（5）AI主导包含ABM参与的优化框架；（6）AI调整ABM初始化参数；（7）AI提供ABM环境；（8）AI辅助选择智能体属性；（9）AI提供ABM中的智能体行为；（10）AI辅助评价ABM表现。每种方式均结合典型研究说明，最后讨论当前局限和未来发展前景。

analysis.basis: 基于作者摘要与已有阅读笔记；未全文核验
analysis.innovation: 提出AI与ABM协作的十类方法角色，区分数据、环境、参数、行为和评价等环节。
analysis.data: 城市研究中的AI—ABM结合文献；摘要未披露纳入数量。
analysis.method: 以十类协作方式组织系统综述，并分析典型研究。
analysis.conclusion: 提供定位AI如何增强ABM的方法框架，并讨论现有限制和未来方向。
analysis.limitation: 待验证的评阅问题：多种AI模块同时引入时，性能提升能否归因于具体协作环节？
analysis.proposal: 在同一ABM上逐项替换初始化、环境与行为模块，使用等计算预算消融比较。
